attributes.name: Corrupted Herald
attributes.powers:
The Corrupted Herald cannot be evaded and is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits.

When any character plays a boon that has the Attack or Ranged trait, she buries a card.

Damage dealt by the Corrupted Herald is dealt to you as Combat damage then dealt to a random character at your location as Fire damage.
